principles: Contracts mirror authority server semantics but remain host-neutral.
Cryptographic helpers are deterministic and testable without contacting the server.
No receipt, no production authority claim.
Endpoint methods are typed wrappers around existing AuthorityClient configuration.
drivers: Need Python/Mac/TS convergence for future enforce runner work.
Need local/off users to remain unblocked.
Need tests that prove signing and client endpoints without requiring a live server.

options.name: A: extend current AuthorityClient plus small contract/signing modules
pros: Reuses existing authority configuration and error handling
Creates reusable primitives for later runner milestones
cons: Does not by itself execute provider CLIs or submit verifier evidence

options.name: B: build a standalone runner package now
cons: Harder to finish with focused smoke tests

chosen: A: extend current AuthorityClient plus small contract/signing modules
rationale: This story is the foundation layer for milestones 1-2, so extending the existing authority client with focused contract/signing modules gives convergence without overclaiming production runner behavior.

preMortem.scenario: Signing helper canonicalization differs from server
preMortem.trigger: Objects with reordered keys or nested arrays hash differently
preMortem.consequence: Receipts or envelopes cannot be verified later
preMortem.mitigation: Smoke tests cover deterministic canonical bytes and reordered object equality.

preMortem.scenario: Client endpoint wrappers silently mutate in off mode
preMortem.trigger: Authority URL is absent but runner method still attempts network I/O
preMortem.consequence: Local users are blocked or confused
preMortem.mitigation: Client smoke covers missing URL/off behavior as controlled failure or zero calls where applicable.

preMortem.scenario: New helpers accidentally classify local evidence as L2+
preMortem.trigger: Boundary classifier treats signed local envelope as receipt-backed
preMortem.mitigation: Adversarial test keeps productionDone/receipt-backed classification false without verified authority receipt.
